comparison.objective: Remove weaker seedlings so one remains per 10 cm; candidate removes manufactured tangs from four installed inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective perception and delicate biological extraction versus recessed coaxial tool alignment, bimanual hammer impact, and metal-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Correct spacing while retaining the stronger seedlings versus four verified fractures, every tang in a tray, and no coil or shell damage. The record supplies no numeric scoring or damage rubric beyond its objective.
comparison.reason: Both remove unwanted material, but selective plant thinning does not test impact-mediated notch fracture or preservation of a threaded insert under lateral-load limits.
